column1: # sdk/api-contract.tsv — the java/** and javax/** surface pico-jvm serves.
# own tables; do not edit by hand. Regenerate with
# after changing an SDK java/** class, BUILTIN_METHODS / BUILTIN_CLASS_NAMES /
# on every app's compiled classes before they are packed into a PAPK.
#   owner                            the class resolves: new / checkcast /
#                                    ldc / array element / lambda SAM type
#   owner<TAB>name<TAB>desc          member served with exactly this descriptor
#   owner<TAB>name<TAB>              member served for any descriptor (native
#   @nameonly<TAB>class              resolves as a catch / super / cast type only,
#                                    advice printed beside a rejected reference
# Resolution (mirrors pico-jvm's dispatch_native): a member is served on an
# owner when a row matches on the owner, on any @extends ancestor, or on
# java/lang/Object; a member of an interface is served when a class that
# @implements it (transitively) serves it, or an app class implementing it
# declares it. A class-file-backed class also serves its declared members
# by inheritance in the usual way.
# ── Tolerated: accepted although not served (static shapes never executed) ──
#   java/lang/Enum.valueOf(Ljava/lang/Class;Ljava/lang/String;)Ljava/lang/Enum; — the synthetic callee of every enum's valueOf(String); unsupported (compatibility matrix), never reached by the demos
#   java/util/Locale.ROOTLjava/util/Locale; — kotlinc's uppercase()/lowercase() pass it to String.toUpperCase(Locale); getstatic on a classfile-less class reads null and the arm ignores it
#   java/util/AbstractList (name only) — compile-time superclass of the kotlin-shim's EnumEntriesList; its <init> falls through to Object
#   java/lang/NoSuchFieldError (name only) — catch_type in every $WhenMappings / $SwitchMap; never thrown by this JVM
#   java/lang/CloneNotSupportedException (name only) — catch_type in every clone() override that calls super.clone(); Object.clone never throws it here
